method.name: get_predicted_display_time_raw
method.description: Returns the current predicted-display [code]XrTime[/code] as a signed 64-bit integer. This is an opaque value in the OpenXR runtime's clock domain. Meta Body Tracking must be enabled; returns [code]0[/code] when body tracking is unavailable or the OpenXR session is not running. Do not compare or convert this value to Godot, Android, camera, or sensor timestamps unless the application has independently established that they share the same clock domain.

method.name: get_body_tracking_calibration_state
method.description: Returns the body tracking calibration state.

method.name: get_body_tracking_fidelity_status
method.description: Returns the body tracking fidelity status.

method.name: is_body_tracking_fidelity_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the body tracking fidelity extension is supported.

method.name: is_body_tracking_height_override_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if height override from the body tracking calibration extension is supported.

method.name: is_full_body_tracking_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the body tracking full body extension is supported.

method.name: locate_body_at_time_raw
method.description: Calls [code]xrLocateBodyJointsFB[/code] at the supplied raw [code]XrTime[/code], relative to the current OpenXR play space. Meta Body Tracking must be enabled. No interpolation or pose history is added by the plugin. The returned dictionary contains [code]requested_time[/code], [code]effective_time[/code], [code]success[/code], [code]error_code[/code], [code]error_string[/code], [code]is_active[/code], [code]confidence[/code], [code]skeleton_changed_count[/code], [code]body_tracking_supported[/code], [code]full_body_supported[/code], [code]joint_count[/code], and [code]joints[/code]. [code]joints[/code] is an array indexed by [XRBodyTracker.Joint], with the same Godot transform convention, orientation conversion, root-orientation correction, and shoulder-position correction as the live [XRBodyTracker] at [code]/user/body_tracker[/code]. For example, read the root at [code]result.joints[XRBodyTracker.JOINT_ROOT][/code]. Each populated joint contains [code]transform[/code] and separate [code]position_valid[/code], [code]orientation_valid[/code], [code]position_tracked[/code], and [code]orientation_tracked[/code] booleans. [code]joint_count[/code] is the number of populated canonical Godot joints, not a native OpenXR array length. The timestamp, runtime status, capability, confidence, and per-joint validity metadata are additional to that familiar body pose. A successful call can still report an inactive body or invalid/untracked joints; callers must inspect the metadata.

method.name: locate_head_at_time_raw
method.description: Calls [code]xrLocateSpace[/code] for an OpenXR view reference space at the supplied raw [code]XrTime[/code], relative to the current OpenXR play space. Meta Body Tracking must be enabled: this is the timestamped companion to the extension's canonical body pose, not a general-purpose HMD tracking API. No interpolation or pose history is added by the plugin. The returned dictionary contains [code]requested_time[/code], [code]success[/code], [code]error_code[/code], [code]error_string[/code], [code]transform[/code], raw [code]location_flags[/code], [code]position_valid[/code], [code]orientation_valid[/code], [code]position_tracked[/code], [code]orientation_tracked[/code], [code]linear_velocity[/code], [code]angular_velocity[/code], raw [code]velocity_flags[/code], [code]linear_velocity_valid[/code], and [code]angular_velocity_valid[/code]. A successful call can still return an invalid or untracked location; callers must inspect the metadata.

method.name: request_body_tracking_fidelity
method.description: Request that the OpenXR runtime use a specified body tracking fidelity.

method.name: reset_body_tracking_calibration
method.description: Reset the body tracking calibration state.

method.name: suggest_body_tracking_height_override
method.description: Suggest a height override in meters for body tracking calibration to the OpenXR runtime. [b]Note:[/b] this value must be within the range of 0.5 and 3.0 meters.
